title: Purple Mage Sorceress
description: A young female character with white hair in an elaborate updo stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with a corset, flowing sleeves, and matching boots, casting glowing purple magical energy from both hands with visible arcane sigils and particles surrounding her.
